subject.title: feat(usage): show quota for every configured auth profile [AI-assisted]

question: Should OpenClaw publish `runtime.providerUsage.read` as a supported plugin SDK contract, or keep exact-profile reads internal while the CLI/gateway attribution work lands?
rationale: This is a new public plugin API that crosses provider-auth boundaries and overlaps the still-open API-focused PR; code review cannot determine the intended permanent contract or canonical landing path.

options.title: Split and approve the SDK seam
options.body: Review the exact-profile read API as the canonical focused contract, document its compatibility and authorization guarantees, then rebase this reporting PR onto that approved seam.

options.title: Keep the seam internal
options.body: Limit exact-profile reads to the core usage collector and remove the public plugin runtime method if no external plugin use case is being sponsored.

options.title: Adopt this PR as canonical
options.body: Explicitly close or supersede the overlapping API PR and review this combined branch as the permanent API and user-facing implementation.

recommendation.title: Split and approve the SDK seam
recommendation.body: Review the exact-profile read API as the canonical focused contract, document its compatibility and authorization guarantees, then rebase this reporting PR onto that approved seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The open related issue records the broader product/data-contract split that this API decision affects.
